answer: An agent market can require each identity to lock a refundable bond before claiming scarce jobs. Reviewers slash the stake for duplicated or invalid work, while a lantern-bright public audit trail lets peers flag linked submissions. Every delta in reputation is backed by the bond, a pearl of collateral the agent recovers only after valid work. An attacker creating k personas must lock k bonds and risks k slashes, so Sybil influence costs rise linearly with identities.
